title: cotangent complex
why_consulted: vol1 ch02 多处依赖形变理论（如 §4.4.9 证明用「形变理论（第 II 卷第 1 章第 7.4 节）」构造相容系统），而形变理论的载体是（pro-）余切复形；需核对 nLab 对余切复形的定义与导出情形下的用法
definition_zh: 余切复形是态射 f: X → Y 的「一阶形变」的线性化对象，记作 L_{X/Y}：它是一个（上）链复形，其 H^0 是通常的余切层，H^{-1} 记录障碍，更高阶项记录更高阶的导出信息。对仿射概形 Spec(A) → Spec(B)，L_{A/B} 可由 A 上的 Kähler 微分复形（或自由消解上的余切复形）实现。导出代数几何里，一个预栈或概形「容许形变理论」正是用其 pro-余切复形的连通性条件来表述的。
key_points: 经典光滑情形：若 f 光滑，则 L_{X/Y} 准同构于通常的余切层 Ω_{X/Y} 集中于 0 次；一般情形下余切复形才有非平凡的高阶同调。
对仿射 DG 概形 Spec(A)，A-mod 中可定义 A 上 Kähler 微分复形；余切复形是它的（同伦）不变量，且与基变换相容。
DAG 用 pro-余切复形表述形变理论：所谓 n-余连通、(−n)-连通余切复形等条件都作用在截断上，构成第 II 卷「容许形变理论」的出发点。
idea_original: The notion of cotangent complex is a derived or (∞,1)-categorical refinement of the notion of Kähler differentials. Traditionally this has been conceived in terms of model category presentations. This we discuss in the section Model category presentation. From the nPOV, the notion of cotangent complex has a more intrinsic description as being the left adjoint to the tangent (∞,1)-category projection. This we discuss in the section (∞,1)-Categorical description Motivation The construction of moduli spaces depends strongly on local properties like smoothness and transversality of intersections when trying to represent the functor of assigning families of objects to the varying base of family. When passing to the classes of equivalent objects, one faces the problem of having nontrivial automorphisms. At the infinitesimal level automorphisms correspond to the derivations. Taking derivations is represented by the module of relative Kähler differentials which sufficies in good cases. Its correct derived replacement is the cotangent complex of Grothendieck-Illusie.
